intent: Travel from the country lane into orchard shade, then climb its stone boundary into sunlit terraces. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The country lane
sections.lesson: Vault the orchard’s low boundary stones. Follow the weight as it swings away.
